_comment: PulseDeck keybindings configuration. Copy this file to your config directory as 'keybindings.json' for PulseDeck to load it. Each entry maps a key (with optional modifiers and mode) to an action. Unknown fields like '_comment' are ignored.
Single-key remap: press 'n' in Normal mode to go to the next station (overrides default 'j' behavior).
Modifier key combination: Ctrl+P opens the command palette.
Parameterized action: Ctrl+1 plays the station assigned to slot 1.
Mode-specific binding: in Search mode, Ctrl+W clears the search (acts as backspace). Does not affect Normal mode.
Override a default binding: rebind Enter to toggle pause instead of playing the selected station.
